C-DROP-PROJECT-INDEX-EXPERIMENT.Summary: Retire the unreferenced tools/index_project.py experiment instead of porting it to GRACE 4, because .grace/graph and .grace/verification already are the project index.
C-DROP-PROJECT-INDEX-EXPERIMENT.Problem: tools/index_project.py (last touched 2026-05-11) walks the repository and writes .graph/project-features.xml. That output path does not exist in the working tree, is absent from .gitignore, and is read by no file in the repository — README.md, AGENTS.md, CI and every other tool never mention it. Half of its feature list was built from openspec/changes/*/proposal.md and openspec/changes/*/specs/**/*.md, which this branch deleted, so those branches can no longer contribute anything; parse_proposal_md and parse_spec_md are now uncalled. The remaining lib/** indexing duplicates what .grace/graph/main.xml (32 modules) and .grace/verification/main.xml (32 entries) declare as durable state. The file also carries a dead stub, scan_paths(), whose loop body is `pass`.

Goals.Goal: Remove the unreferenced indexer so that no tool in the repository claims a second, divergent project index.
Keep the two live data-fetch scripts untouched: they regenerate the assets the app loads at runtime.
Leave the repository with a single index of record, .grace/graph plus .grace/verification, validated by the GRACE CLI.

Constraints.Constraint: GRACE 4 durable state changes only through the approved change lifecycle; no generator script may write files inside .grace/.
The repository has no Python test harness or Python tooling configuration, so verification must be a compile check plus repository greps.
tools/fetch_gt7_cars.py and tools/fetch_gt7_tracks.py are live tooling and stay byte-identical.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No replacement indexer is written. .grace/graph/main.xml (modules M-*) and .grace/verification/main.xml (entries V-M-*) already answer what index_project.py tried to answer.
No generated file is added under .grace/, because the CLI validates that directory's grammar and projections.
No change to the app's lib/**, test/** or asset content; this is tooling hygiene only.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tools/index_project.py is gone from the working tree and from the git index.
No tracked file references index_project, .graph/ or project-features.
tools/fetch_gt7_cars.py and tools/fetch_gt7_tracks.py are byte-identical to the baseline commit.
The two fetch scripts still compile under python3 -m py_compile.
grace lint --path . --assertions current still reports zero errors and zero warnings.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: ls tools/index_project.py ; git grep -n "index_project\|project-features" ; python3 -m py_compile tools/fetch_gt7_cars.py tools/fetch_gt7_tracks.py ; grace lint --path . --assertions current
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The ls exits non-zero (file absent), the grep returns no tracked match, py_compile exits zero for both fetch scripts, and grace lint prints "Errors: 0 / Warnings: 0".

Assumptions.Assumption: The tool's only entry point is main() under __main__; no module imports tools/index_project.
tools/__pycache__ is local build noise and untracked.
The user confirmed index_project.py and the .graph idea were an experiment whose remaining value is covered by .grace.
